purpose: Documented, reviewed drift of R-169 frozen configuration after R-169 closed (done). A freeze guards reproducibility of the frozen runs; it does not forbid evolving the product forever. Every entry: which file moved, frozen vs current short sha256, why, and the consequence. The runners' check_freeze is NOT relaxed: v2-v5 runners refuse any new held-out run on drift. Tests accept drift only when it matches this ledger exactly; any further change needs a new entry.

entries.change: R-170 batch 10: code_generator returns tool_output.code on the supplied-code path (was metadata only) and no longer cuts LLM code at 8000 chars (bounded at 64000, omitted above with size+sha256).
entries.consequence: All R-169 results (v1-v5, b1-b3, and b4s which runs on its own pre-change commit) stay attributable to the frozen code; new held-out runs of v2-v5 are refused by check_freeze. The v5 code_generator path used by the code tasks now returns the full code text (its answer and ok are unchanged).
